entities.name: Mythohistory of Dominaria
entities.description: The earliest known period of Dominaria's history, covering its most ancient legends.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane whose earliest history is described.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: The being that spawned the first true dragons on Dominaria.

entities.name: Elder Dragons
entities.description: The first dragons, progenitors of all dragon broods.

entities.name: Birth of the Elder Dragons
entities.description: The spawning of the first true dragons around -20,000 AR.

entities.name: Dragon-killers' War
entities.description: The first great conflict between mortals and the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: A millennia-long struggle that killed or diminished nearly all Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Fall of the Primevals
entities.description: The destruction of the primeval dragonlords.

entities.name: Fall of the Numena
entities.description: The downfall of the godlike mages who supplanted the primevals.

entities.name: Shattering of Madara
entities.description: The world's first clash involving Planeswalkers.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: A region of Dominaria shattered in the era's end.

events.summary: The Ur-Dragon spawned the first true dragons, the Elder Dragons, around -20,000 AR.
events.quote: the spawning of the first true dragons on Dominaria by the Ur-Dragon around -20,000 AR

events.summary: The Dragon-killers' War was the first great conflict between mortals and the Elder Dragons.
events.quote: The Dragon-killers' War is regarded as the first great conflict between mortals and the Elder Dragons

events.summary: The Elder Dragon War killed or diminished nearly all Elder Dragons.
events.quote: a millennia-long struggle that led to the death or diminishment of nearly all Elder Dragons

events.summary: The Fall of the Primevals destroyed the primeval dragonlords who had inherited power from the Elder Dragons.
events.quote: The Fall of the Primevals marked the destruction of the primeval dragonlords

events.summary: The Shattering of Madara concluded the era as the world's first clash involving Planeswalkers.
events.quote: the Shattering of Madara , the world's first clash involving Planeswalkers

relations.quote: the spawning of the first true dragons on Dominaria by the Ur-Dragon
